items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 03 May 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the mid-Atlantic, with a slack area of low pressure centred over England, bringing various weak fronts across the British Isles.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northeast 2 to 4, increasing 4 occasionally 5 in the west of the area tomorrow morning, but falling Variable 3 or less in the east.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at first, becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northerly 3 or 4 in the west of the area, but Variable 3 or less in the east, becoming North or Northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in all waters tomorrow afternoon, but then falling Variable 3 or less in the west. Increasing North or Northwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
